summary: Oklo Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution agreement to sell up to $1 billion of Class A common stock through multiple sales agents, including Goldman Sachs and BofA Securities. Sales may be made on NYSE or OTC at prevailing market prices with a 1.5% commission. The filing also contemplates potential forward sale agreements. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms or premium apply. Watch for dilution from gradual share sales.
